tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi cho ga bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par 'joms pa'i sgo nas rig pa gtad pa dang*/ gzungs kyi cho ga byed par 'dod pas/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas gang yang rung bar maṇ+ḍal legs par byas te/ bum pa gnyis la kha rgyan mgul chings gzungs thag /bum sman tshogs par byas te/ gu gul gyis bdug cing*/ oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa dang*/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis bsang*/ dkar gsum dang*/ mngar gsum dang chu gtsang ma sbyar bas bkang nas/ legs par bshams te mchod pa'i tshogs ci 'byor pas bskor bar bya'o// gtor ma cha gsum mam/ yang na gcig la brten kyang rung ngo*// de ltar rgyu bum pa'i chos bdun rdzogs nas/ las bum gyi nang du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje rgya gram/ g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ la sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs nas/ oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bsnyen pa ci rigs pa byas nas/ thog mar khrus byas te/ de dag ni sngon du 'gro ba'o// dngos gzhi la bzhi ste/ byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa dang*/ rtsa ba bdun gyi man ngag /dbang bskur ba dang*/ khrus kyi cho ga'o// dang po la bzhi las/ bdag byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sems bskyed cing swa bhā'i sngags brjod nas/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar zla ba dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pa las rang gi phung po yongs su sbyangs te/ rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog dkar la sngo ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa bdud rtsi'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sku la sbrul dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sku la 'od zer rab tu 'bar bar bsgom mo// de'i spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po rnams bsgoms te/ lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab bo// gnyis pa gnas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ 'byung po la gtor ma btang la/ bdag phyag na rdo rje'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ steng rdo rje'i bla bre/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs rdo rje'i ra ba dang rtsig par byin gyis brlab bo// badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes pas rgyas gdab bo// gsum pa bum pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bdag phyag na rdo rje'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ bum pa 'od du zhu/ yi ge bh+rūm̐ gcig tu gyur/ bh+rūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las/ rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur te/ shar phyogs shel las grub ste dkar la 'tsher ba/ lho bai ḍūr+ya las grub ste sngo/ nub pad ma rā ga dmar/ byang in+d+ra nī la ljang*/ rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa a a/ zhes byin gyis brlab bo/ bzhi pa bum pa'i rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ pañtsa li ka sarba sid+dhi swā hā/ oṃ pañtsa bi te swā hā/ oṃ tri pa sha sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ oṃ pañtsa rū pi ni sid+dhi hūm̐/ oṃ pañtsa rat+na sid+dhi hūm̐/ oṃ pañtsa gar+bha sid+dhi hūm̐/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ oṃ khaṃ dzñā na rasmi a dhiṣ+ṭhā na sid+dhi hūm̐/ oṃ kalpa brig sha sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer rdzas rnams la phog /'od du zhu ba las/ bum pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu dang*/ de'i dbus su pad+ma dang zla ba nyi ma'i steng du/ yi ge hūm̐ gnyis/ phyogs bcu sgo bzhir yang de kho na bzhin bsgoms te/ lha bcu drug gi rang bzhin du blta'o// de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bcu drug tu gyur/

de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ lha bcu drug gi dkyil 'khor du gyur par blta ste/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog dkar la sngo ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ye shes kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa'i steng na khro bo'i zhal phyung ba/ sku las 'od zer dang khro chung gi tshogs 'phro ba/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can du bsgom mo// de'i mdun du yum rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rdo rje lcags sgrog phyar ba/ g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar gyi cod pan dang mu tig gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o// phyogs bcur khro bo chen po bcu sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa gdengs pa/ g.yon pa bdud rtsi'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i chas dang ldan par bsgom/ shar sgor lcags kyu ma dkar mo/ lho sgor zhags pa ma ser mo/ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma dmar mo/ byang sgor dril bu ma ljang gu/ de ltar lha bcu drug gi spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po bsgoms te/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab bo// de nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la hūm̐/ de la snying po'i sngags kyis g.yas su bskor bar bsgoms te byin gyis brlab par bya'o// gnyis pa rtsa ba bdun gyi man ngag la/ spyan drang ba dang*/ bzhugs su gsol ba dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ phrin las dang*/ bshags pa bya ba bdun las/ dang po spyan drang ba ni/

hūm̐/ 'og min gnas mchog dam pa nas// lcang lo can gyi pho brang du// nor bu brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas nas// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// rdo rje rnam 'joms lha tshogs rnams// dad pa'i dbang gis spyan 'dren na// thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐/ sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang ngo*// gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang*// nyon mongs mi spang gos pa med// ma chags rang bzhin dag pas na// pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhān+tu/ gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs rnams// sku mchog stobs chen ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// gsung mchog sgra chen ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs mchog ye shes ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// nga bdag 'joms pa phyag na rdo rje yab yum bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// mi dge bcu 'joms khro bo bcu la phyag 'tshal lo// phrin las rnam bzhi sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū hoḥ pra ti pū ho/ a la la ho/ bzhi pa mchod pa ni/ byin gyis brlabs la/ gzugs snang sna tshogs 'bul lo spyan gyis mchod pa bzhes// sgra snyan sna tshogs 'bul lo snyan gyis mchod pa bzhes// dri mchog sna tshogs 'bul lo shangs kyis mchod pa bzhes// ro mchog sna tshogs 'bul lo ljags kyis mchod pa bzhes// reg bya sna tshogs 'bul lo sku yis mchod pa bzhes// gtor ma sna tshogs 'bul lo ljags kyis mchod pa bzhes// gzugs kyi lha mo spyan la thim// sgra yi lha mo snyan la thim// dri yi lha mo shangs la thim// ro yi lha mo ljags la thim// reg gi lha mo lus la thim// 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa bzhes// oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ko'u shi ka hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra a laṅka ra hūm̐/

oṃ ba liṃ pū dza a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ lnga pa bstod pa ni/ bcom ldan rdo rje rnam 'joms lha tshogs rnams// sku yi rdo rje skye shi med la phyag 'tshal bstod// gsung gi rdo rje 'gag pa med la phyag 'tshal bstod// thugs kyi rdo rje mtshan ma med la phyag 'tshal bstod// yon tan rdo rje cir yang snang la phyag 'tshal bstod// phrin las rdo rje sna tshogs grub la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan rdo rje rnam 'joms 'khor bcas ni// sku mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer can// gsung mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer can// thugs mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer can// lus ngag yid gsum 'joms mdzad pa'i// rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ khyod la mchod pa phul pa'i bsod nams kyis// bdag gi dge ba'i tshogs rnams 'phel ba dang*// bsam pa grub par thugs rjes gzung du gsol// drug pa gtor ma gtang zhing phrin las bcol ba ni/ gtor ma cha gsum ltar bsngo ba'am/ yang na bsdus pa'i gtor ma gcig kyang rung ste/ swa bhā was sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dkar gsum mngar gsum la sogs pa'i rdzas kyi dngos po rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan lngar bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa lha bcu drug gi lha tshogs rnams kyis gsol bar bsam la/ rtsa ba'i gzungs thung gi zhabs su/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pa/ bdun gsum la sogs pa brjod la 'bul lo// gsang sngags nang ltar byed na/ sman dang rak+ta gtor ma rnams me rlung gi sbyor bas byin gyis brlabs la dbul zhing*/ spros pa la dga' na/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pas bstod do// phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la// rdo rje rnam 'joms bstan pa dar// 'jigs pa'i khro bo bstan srung po// ri rab tsam gyi sku bzhengs la// gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdangs 'tshal// rtsi shing tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs// rgya mtsho tsam gyi mchod pa bzhes// bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos// bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod// bdud rtsi sman gyi gtor ma bzhes// mdzes pa'i me tog gtor ma bzhes// rak+sha rgyan gyi mchod pa bzhes// rnal 'byor sgrub pa po bdag gis// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par gyis// tshe ring nad med dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob nas// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub can gyis sdongs grogs mdzod// skabs 'dir 'od zer gyi spro bsdu bya zhing*/

snying po gzungs ring gang yin la bsnyen pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs bya'o// bdun pa sdig pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐/ na mo dus gsum sdig pa ci bgyis pa// rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// slan chad sdom pa'i tshul la gnas lags kyis// dus 'dir bag chags ma lus dag gyur cig /bdag gis las ngan byas pas lus ngan thob/ khams gsum sdig pa'i tshang skyes pas// ngag gis sdig byas rdzun tshig mang du brjod// sems kyis blo nor log par lta ba sogs// 'di 'dra'i dbang gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa// bkram pa'i lha tshogs rnams la mthol lo bshags// ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang*// de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin la// 'gal 'khrul gra chag nyams pa bzod par gsol// thugs dang 'gal ba mchis na gnod ma mdzad// ces bshags pa byas nas/ gzungs kyi cho ga yun ring du byed na/ thun gsum mam bzhir bya'o// gsum pa dbang bskur ba ni/ sgrub pa thon nas bum pa lag tu blangs te/ ting nge 'dzin ni/ rnam par 'joms pa lha bcu drug gi dkyil 'khor gyi sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ka byung ste/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag cing*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs par bsgom mo// bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ bum pa'i don ni chos nyid skye ba med/ kha rgyan kun 'byung dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing*// mgul chings shes bya dar gyi cod pan 'phur// mi 'gyur rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi yis mdzes// rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs rgyu las byung*// dri med dag pa lha yi gzhal yas khang*// sman lnga 'bru lnga snying po lnga lha lnga// sku lnga gsung lnga thugs lnga ye shes lnga// stobs lngas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bum pa ru// rang bzhin dag pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud phyung pas// las dang nyon mongs bag chags dag gyur cig /oṃ bud+dha bai ro tsa na oṃ/ badz+ra bai ro tsa na hūm̐/

rat+na bai ro tsa na swā/ pad+ma bai ro tsa na āṃ/ karma bai ro tsa na hā/ oṃ bud+dha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rat+na ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa swā/ pad+ma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa āṃ/ karma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hā/ bai ro tsa na oṃ/ kā ya pā la a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ a mi de ba hrīḥ wāka pā la a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ tsit+ta pā la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes lnga yis dbang bskur cing*// gzhan la yang de ltar bya'o// bzhi pa khrus kyi cho ga ni/ bdag phyag na rdo rje'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lha bcu drug la phog ste lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las/ lha'i chu dag pa dkar la 'tsher ba dri ma med pa'i chu/ nad thams cad kyi gnyen por gyur pa/ dkar lhang lhang 'tsher ba de lta bu'i chu de/ nangs par nyi ma rtse shar la kha shar du bltas la/ rin po che'i zangs gzhong bzed la 'di skad do// na mo sri zhu'i mgron du gyur pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas ji snyed bzhugs pa rnams sku khrus la gshegs su gsol/ phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gang lags pa/ bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bkra shis shog /dza ya dza ya rgyal bar gyur cig /gzhan yang yon tan gyi mgron du gyur pa/ dpal tshangs pa dang*/ brgya byin dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dang*/ phyogs skyong ba bcu dang*/ dpal ha ri ka dang*/ pañtsi ka dang*/ gang ba bzang po dang*/ nor bu bzang po dang*/ lngas rtsen dang*/ bde ba'i ri bo dang*/ ded dpon dang*/ shes pa'i sgron ma la sogs te/ dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma khyed rnams mi dgyes pa thams cad sku khrus la gshegs su gsol/ phan mdzad lha yi= 'gre'o// bkra shis dam pa= dza ya dza ya= gzhan yang ma hā de wa la sogs pa lha chen po brgyad/ mtha' yas dang 'jog po la sogs te klu chen po brgyad/ nyi ma dang zla ba la sogs te gza' chen po brgyad/

smin drug dang snar ma la sogs rgyu skar gyi lha mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ da na dang da na ti la sogs te gnod sbyin chen po brgyad/ lto 'phye dang grul bum la sogs te lha ma srin sde brgyad/ khyod rnams mi dgyes pa thams cad sku khrus la gshegs su gsol/ phan mdzad lha yi= bkra shis dam pa= dza ya dza ya= gzhan yang yul bdag /sa steng gi lha dang*/ 'og gi klu dang*/ sa bdag dang*/ 'phral gang mtho ba'i rkyen bgegs dang*/ lung pa phu mda'i g.ya' ri dang*/ gangs ri la gnas pa'i lha klu gnod sbyin dang*/ yul lha dang*/ dmu dang*/ btsan la sogs pa khyed rnams kyi mi dgyes pa thams cad sku khrus la gshegs su gsol/ phan mdzad= bkra shis= dza ya= gzhan yang*/ pho lha/ dgra lha/ srog lha dang*/ le 'u'i lha dang*/ pha myes kyi mtshun dang*/ ma phyi'i sman dang*/ lha mtshun khyed rnams mi dgyes pa thams cad sku khrus la gshegs su gsol/ phan mdzad= bkra shis= dza ya= gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dang*/ yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ zas ngan ltor zos pa dang*/ gos ngan lus la gyon pa dang*/ phyogs ngan du phyin pa dang*/ rme dang*/ khram dang*/ byur gyi skal gyis phog pa dang*/ lus kyi na tsha dang*/ sems kyi sdug bsngal dang*/ mi gtsang ba'i nad thams cad dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad ye shes kyi chu bo'i khrus kyis dag par gyur cig /phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /dza ya dza ya rgyal bar gyur cig /ces khrus gsol bar bya'o// gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la smon lam/ bkra shis/ bsngo ba dang gsum las/ smon lam gdab pa ni/ bkra shis rgyal byed bum pas dbang bskur bas// ye shes dbang bcu rnams la dbang byed pa// log 'dren bdud bzhi'i dgra las rab rgyal te// rnam pa kun mkhyen ye shes thob par shog /'bru mchog rnam pa mang pos dbang bskur bas// 'bras bu rnam pa mang po smin pa ltar// dge ba'i lo thog mang po smin rgyas te// ma 'dres bco brgyad chos dang ldan par shog

/spos mchog rnam pa lnga yis dbang bskur bas// dri zhim spos kyis tsha ba'i gdung sel ltar// tshad med la sogs zag med bdud rtsi lngas// nyon mongs lnga yi gdung ba sel bar shog /sman mchog rnam pa lnga yis dbang bskur bas// 'jig rten sman pa'i rgyal po dam pa ste// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad las phyir bsal te// stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs las thar bar shog /rin chen rnam pa lnga yis dbang bskur bas// yid bzhin nor bus re ba kun skong ltar// 'gro don bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// yid bzhin yon tan chos dang ldan par shog /snying po rnam pa lnga yis dbang bskur bas// dge ba'i rtsa ba rgyu yi dbang po las// dge bcu ma lus dbyings su smin gyur te// snying po bla med 'bras bu thob par shog /mgul chings cod pan lnga yis dbang bskur bas// rdo rje rgyal mtshan gtso bor dbang bskur te// ye shes rnam pa mang po rdzogs gyur nas// bde gshegs rigs lnga'i dbang dang ldan par shog /kha rgyan 'bras bu chags pas dbang bskur bas// dpag bsam shing gis re ba kun skong ltar// 'gro don bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// 'bras bu can gyi shing dang ldan par shog /gzungs thag ye shes lnga yis dbang bskur bas// don gyi gzungs dang tshig gi gzungs ldan zhing*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang ye shes lnga// yon tan mi 'bral gzungs dang ldan par shog /de ltar gzungs kyi bum pa 'di bzhengs su gsol te/ yar gang zhing gtams pa bzhin/ deng gi yon bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ dbang thang dang*/ chus srid thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du/ tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du gang zhing rgyas pa bzhin nam/ gangs ri la zla ba shar bzhin je che je cher rgyas te gsal bar gyur cig /de ltar gzungs kyi bum pa 'di/ yon bdag gi sku la gsol te/ zla ba mar ngo zad cing stong pa ltar/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad ni tshes bcu drug nas gnam stong gi bar du zad cing stong pa'am/

bya sgro mer bsregs pa bzhin du je chung je chung song ste byang zhing dag par gyur cig /de ltar gyur pa'i byin rlabs kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhal dro bar gyur cig /bum pa bkra shis par gyur cig /yon gyi bdag po rnams tshe ring zhing nad med par gyur cig /yul khams thams cad du mi nad dang phyugs nad thams cad rgyun chad nas/ lo phyugs ni rtag tu legs/ dbus su yul mi 'khrugs/ mtha' nas dgra mi ldang*/ lhan ne lham me lhang nge*/ bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /ces pa'i smon lam gdab par bya'o// gnyis pa ni bkra shis gang rung brjod/ gsum pa dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo/ 'di'i brgyud pa/ slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad de/ bi ma la mi tras bod du byon nas/ sgrags kyi yang thog tu gnyags dzñā na ku mā ras bsgyur nas/ lha dpal gyi ye shes la bshad/ des sru legs pa'i sgron ma la bshad/ des nā ro tshe 'byin la/ des gnubs ston bla ma la/ des bla ma rgya la/ des bla ma ras pa la/ des bla ma rin po che rang byung rdo rje la/ slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa'i dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rig pa gtad pa dang*/ gzungs kyi cho ga'i rim pa 'di/ lag len shin tu bde bar rang byung rdo rjes bsgrigs pa rdzogs so/// /
